relations.text: HPとHewlett Packard Enterpriseが、両事業の分離に伴う分離・配布契約などを結んだ
relations.text_en: HP and Hewlett Packard Enterprise entered into a separation and distribution agreement and other agreements in connection with the separation of the two businesses

source.label: HP 10-K
source.quote: We and Hewlett Packard Enterprise entered into a separation and distribution agreement and various other agreements in connection with the separation of the two businesses.

relations.text: HPEは、分離契約に基づきHP Inc.の特定の債務について全額補償する義務を負う可能性がある
relations.text_en: Under the Separation agreements, HPE may be obligated to fully indemnify HP Inc. for certain liabilities

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: We may be obligated to fully indemnify HP Inc. for certain liabilities under the Separation agreements or HP Inc. may not be able to fully cover their indemnification obligations to us under the same Separation agreements.

relations.text: HPEとDXCの間の分離・配布契約で、双方が既存の訴訟の対応で協力することに合意した
relations.text_en: Under the Separation and Distribution Agreements between HPE and DXC, the parties agreed to cooperate in managing certain existing litigation

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: As part of the Separation and Distribution Agreements between Hewlett Packard Enterprise and HP Inc., Hewlett Packard Enterprise and DXC, and Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Seattle SpinCo, the parties to each agreement agreed to cooperate with each other in managing certain existing litigation related to both parties' businesses.

relations.text: HPEとDXCテクノロジーの間には、DXC Tax Matters Agreementが存在する
relations.text_en: HPE and DXC Technology are party to the DXC Tax Matters Agreement.

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: See Note 18, “Guarantees and Indemnifications,” for a description of the DXC Tax Matters Agreement and Micro Focus Tax Matters Agreement.

relations.text: 2024年9月、JPMorgan Chase Bankなどと約120億ドルの無担保シニア遅延引出しタームローン枠の契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In September 2024, HPE entered into term loan agreements with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and others for approximately $12.0 billion of senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facilities

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: In September 2024, the Company entered into term loan agreements with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A, Citibank, N.A., and Mizuho Bank, Ltd. for approximately $ 12.0 billion of senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facilities, comprised of an approximately $ 9.0 billion 364-day tranche and a $ 3.0 billion three-year tranche, subject to customary conditions.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 2024年9月12日付の5年クレジット契約で、JPMorgan Chase Bankが管理代理人を務める
relations.text_en: Under the Five-Year Credit Agreement dated September 12, 2024, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is Administrative Processing Agent and Co-Administrative Agent

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: 10.32 Five-Year Credit Agreement, dated as of September 12, 2024, among Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company, the Borrowing Subsidiaries from time to time party thereto, the Lenders party thereto, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as Administrative Processing Agent and Co-Administrative Agent, and Citibank, N.A., as Co-Administrative Agent.

companies.name: アリスタネットワークス

relations.text: ヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズと競合する

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors are technology vendors, such as Cisco Systems, Inc., Arista Networks Inc, Nokia Corporation, Huawei Technologies Co.

relations.text: ヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズと競合する

source.label: Arista Networks 10-K
source.quote: The data center and campus networking markets have historically been dominated by Cisco, with competition also coming from other large network equipment and system vendors, including Dell/EMC, Extreme Networks, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Huawei, Juniper Networks, Nvidia, and white box networking vendors that utilize open-source operating systems.

relations.text: シスコは、データセンター・インフラでHPEの主な競合を担う
relations.text_en: Cisco is a primary competitor of HPE in data center infrastructure.

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors in data center infrastructure are technology vendors, such as Dell Technologies Inc., Super Micro Computer, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., and Lenovo Group Ltd.

relations.text: IBM Global Financingは、HPEの金融サービス事業の競合である
relations.text_en: IBM Global Financing competes with HPE's Financial Services business.

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: Financial Services primarily competes with captive financing companies, such as IBM Global Financing, Dell Financial Services, and Cisco Capital, as well as banks and other financial institutions.
source.note: 金融サービス事業に限った競合です。
source.note_en: Competitor of the financing business only.

relations.text: ヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズと競合する

source.label: Ciena 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include Nokia, Huawei, Cisco, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, and ZTE.

relations.text: ヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズと競合する

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include companies such as Check Point, Cisco, CrowdStrike, F5 Networks, HPE, Huawei, Microsoft, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, SonicWALL, Sophos, and Zscaler.
